boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-admission activities drawn from Massachusetts Maritime Academy and nearby Cape Cod Canal public resources.

cards.title: Browse the Canal museum
cards.subtitle: Cape Cod Canal Visitor Center, Sandwich
cards.notes: Walk through the free museum exhibits, then use the displays to compare canal operations, wildlife, and the vessels moving through the waterway.
cards.short_summary: A free, family-friendly canal museum with interactive exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers describes the Visitor Center museum as free and family friendly.
cards.source_title: Cape Cod Canal — U.S. Army Corps of Engineers
cards.access_notes: The Corps lists 2026 seasonal Visitor Center hours; confirm the day before traveling.

cards.entity_name: Retired U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Patrol Boat
cards.title: Step aboard the retired patrol boat
cards.subtitle: Inside Cape Cod Canal Visitor Center, Sandwich
cards.notes: Add the retired 40-foot Corps patrol boat to a Visitor Center stop, and pair it with the nearby exhibits on the canal’s operation.
cards.short_summary: A named historic vessel exhibit inside the free Visitor Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The free Visitor Center lets visitors board a retired 40-foot U.S. Army Corps of Engineers patrol boat.
cards.source_title: Cape Cod Canal — U.S. Army Corps of Engineers
cards.access_notes: This exhibit is within the seasonal Visitor Center; use the Corps’ posted hours.

cards.title: Captain the virtual tugboat
cards.subtitle: Cape Cod Canal Visitor Center, Sandwich
cards.notes: Take turns at the Visitor Center’s virtual tugboat experience, then compare its route with the live vessels visible from the canal waterfront.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on tugboat simulation at the free Visitor Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Corps lists a virtual tugboat experience among the free Visitor Center’s interactive exhibits.
cards.source_title: Cape Cod Canal — U.S. Army Corps of Engineers
cards.access_notes: Available during the Cape Cod Canal Visitor Center’s seasonal operating period.

cards.entity_name: Cape Cod Canal Live Radar and Camera Display
cards.title: Track ships on the live display
cards.subtitle: Cape Cod Canal Visitor Center, Sandwich
cards.notes: Use the live radar and camera images to locate canal traffic, then head to the waterfront deck to look for the vessels on screen.
cards.short_summary: Live vessel-tracking displays turn ship watching into a shared activity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Visitor Center’s free exhibits include live radar and camera images for locating vessels in the canal.
cards.source_title: Cape Cod Canal — U.S. Army Corps of Engineers
cards.access_notes: The display is inside the seasonal Visitor Center; check the Corps’ current schedule.

cards.entity_name: Cape Cod Canal Ranger Interpretive Program
cards.title: Request a ranger-led canal program
cards.subtitle: Cape Cod Canal, Bourne and Sandwich
cards.notes: Coordinate a school, civic, or scouting group and request a ranger program about the canal’s engineering, natural history, or marine operations.
cards.short_summary: Free ranger programs and tours are available to organized groups on request.
cards.evidence_claim: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers states that group tours and interpretive programs are available free of charge upon request.
cards.source_title: Cape Cod Canal — U.S. Army Corps of Engineers
cards.access_notes: For school, civic, or scouting groups; arrange directly with Cape Cod Canal park rangers.

cards.title: Reserve a picnic pavilion
cards.subtitle: Midway Recreation Area, Cape Cod Canal
cards.notes: For an organized group get-together, ask the park ranger about the pavilion’s no-cost Special Facility Permit reservation process before setting plans.
cards.short_summary: A named canal picnic pavilion available to qualifying groups at no cost.
cards.evidence_claim: The Corps says Midway Recreation Area’s picnic pavilion can be reserved for group functions at no cost via Special Facility Permit.
cards.source_title: Cape Cod Canal — U.S. Army Corps of Engineers
cards.access_notes: Open Memorial Day weekend through Columbus Day weekend; a Special Facility Permit request is required for group reservation.

cards.title: Try an Investment Club lesson
cards.subtitle: Massachusetts Maritime Academy
cards.notes: Join an interactive lesson or semester challenge to learn investing fundamentals with other students; the Academy says the club is free to join.
cards.short_summary: A free-to-join student club focused on investment fundamentals.
cards.evidence_claim: Massachusetts Maritime Academy states that the MMA Investment Club is free to join and open to all students.
cards.source_title: SGA Club and Organizations | Massachusetts Maritime Academy
cards.access_notes: Open to all Massachusetts Maritime Academy students; verify meeting details with the club.

cards.title: Lift in the Free Weight Room
cards.subtitle: Clean Harbors Athletics Center, Massachusetts Maritime Academy
cards.notes: Plan a no-cost strength session using the power rack, free weights, or selectorized equipment, and keep the workout appropriate to your experience.
cards.short_summary: A campus weight room expressly open to cadets, faculty, and staff.
cards.evidence_claim: Massachusetts Maritime Academy says the Free Weight Room is open to all cadets, faculty, and staff.
cards.source_title: Fitness on Campus | Massachusetts Maritime Academy
cards.access_notes: Campus access is limited to cadets, faculty, and staff; follow Athletics Center rules.

cards.title: Flip through The Muster yearbooks
cards.subtitle: Massachusetts Maritime Academy Library online collection
cards.notes: Open a digitized issue of The Muster with friends and browse Academy memories, portraits, ceremonies, and student photography from past academic years.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy Library says anyone may freely read digitized issues of Massachusetts Maritime Academy yearbooks.
cards.access_notes: Available online; the Library links directly to the digitized yearbook collection.

cards.entity_name: Massachusetts Maritime Academy Library Collection Search
cards.title: Search the Library collection together
cards.subtitle: ABS Information Commons, Massachusetts Maritime Academy
cards.notes: Use the Library search to pull up books, journals, videos, and other materials for a shared research question or a low-key study session.
cards.short_summary: Anyone can search the Academy Library’s complete collection.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy Library states that anyone may search through its entire collection.
cards.access_notes: Anyone may search the collection; online resources themselves are restricted to current students and staff.
